items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1960-11-30
items.q: I think that was Geechee Robinson's arrangement. Tremor player. Let me put this- William Robinson. William Geechee Robinson.

ctx.x: No, I mean you had the same men.

Yeah. Yeah. All records. Okay. Okay. No, I mean you had the same men for all records? Or did it change? No, we didn't make any more records after we made those four. Just one time. Yeah. Yeah. We made all those sections at one time. It was on for carrying lay-up. Mm-hmm . I was on the vocally label. Who is that? Taylor, Louis Cutler. Hyrum Harden. Boy from Dallas. Which one did the growl work? Hyrum Harden. He did the growl work. Yeah, he was growl man. Did he use a mute when he growl? He used to use a plunger.…
